blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a 45-year-old man and seized 14.4 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) worth P98,532. The cops also reportedly seized from the suspect six live rounds of ammunition during a search warrant operation in Bacarra town, Ilocos Norte on Thursday, Oct. 22. The Bacarra Municipal Police Station (MPS) identified the suspect as a high-value individual in the illegal drug trade. The Inquirer learned from other sources that the suspect is a village councilor. Police also confiscated a metal tong, one live round of .38-caliber ammunition, and five live rounds of .45-caliber ammunition during the operation. […]...
